title: DBFlux redesign: Export and import formats · dark
brief: Design catch-up for the export wizard (PRs #1316 HTML, Markdown and XML, #1317 per-format options, #1318 SQL INSERT export) and the import wizard file entry (open PR #1321). Shows what the wizards ship after the alignment work (branch feat/805-wizard-design-align), in the Bolt Byzantium app system: the Tables footer with Cancel, 140 px labels, the Confirm step, and the closing, reading and next-step copy.

artboards.title: Export wizard: Format step with per-format options
artboards.tradeoff: Islands, dark: Shows every option set and its visibility rule on one board; the CSV dialog is complete, the other formats are compact, so the exact dialog height of each format is not drawn.

artboards.title: Export wizard: unavailable, blocked and failed states (SQL not offered, invalid batch size, no folder, no tables, failed run)
artboards.tradeoff: Islands, dark: Puts every state where an option is missing or Continue is blocked on one board so each reason can be compared; each is a full dialog, which makes the board wide and tall.

artboards.title: Import wizard: Pick Source, reading a file or folder, and a picked file
artboards.tradeoff: Islands, dark: Treats the file entry as a second source on the existing step rather than a separate wizard; the source buttons stay plain, so the two sources read as equals.

artboards.title: Import wizard: CSV options, JSON variant, column mapping and Truncate unavailable
artboards.tradeoff: Islands, dark: Draws the mapping controls exactly as the app has them, one pair rebind at a time, instead of proposing a column list the code does not have; also shows the keyboard cursor with the design system focus state and a key legend.

artboards.title: Import wizard: error states (header decode, broken JSON, lookup failure, failed run, folder errors)
artboards.tradeoff: Islands, dark: Uses one error block for the picker, for Configure and for the three folder errors, so every place a source can fail looks alike; every block ends with the next step, and a failed run ends on a Done step with a closing line.

artboards.title: Wizards: the Confirm step (export plan, import destructive confirmation)
artboards.tradeoff: Islands, dark: Export confirms a summary with Back, Cancel and Start Export; import confirms only a Recreate or Truncate plan, with the affected tables and modes in the shared danger block and Back, Cancel and Yes, proceed in the footer.

artboards.title: Import wizard: spreadsheet import (Sheet dropdown, empty or invalid sheet, error cell, sheet too large, XML)
artboards.tradeoff: Islands, dark: Adds a single Sheet row to the existing Configure step instead of a separate sheet wizard, and reuses the shared danger block for every failure; sheet names only, so the dropdown does not promise row counts the reader may not give cheaply.

artboards.title: Import wizard: run a SQL script (Configure, Confirm, Running, Done, Pick Source errors)
artboards.tradeoff: Islands, dark: Keeps the script flow inside the import wizard with its four-step rail rather than a new dialog, and skips Confirm when nothing is destructive; the cost is that a plain write-only script starts running from one button, so that button is labelled Run Script.
